# U52: Anyone works an inbox of 75 markups and pieces of feedback down to nothing new: a folded row handled together, keys or Next, filters and search, and batches closed a page at a time

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `INBOX-TRIAGE`, `MARKUP-INBOX`, `FEEDBACK-INBOX`
- **Budget:** at most 30 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/feedback` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 4616

## Steps and checks

- **Check:** It fails if U52 needs the build with a database address (DOWN).
- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- A database for the build whose database never answers (`fakeSupabase`).
- 75 inbox items, as the database keeps them (`seed75`).
- Go to `/feedback` in the demo, on a build whose database can’t be reached.
- **Check:** An Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ 75 new, in 68 rows (6 markups on Home's week strip fold into one, 3 on a goal's scorecard into another), 25 a page.
- _Note:_ Feedback is its own page now (backlog WS): its New tab carries the count.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if New {tabCount(inbox, 'New')}, {rows.count()} rows on the page, the menu says “75 new”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “inbox of 75”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Search finds the folded row; it opens, and marking it in hand marks all 6.
- **Step.** Type “week strip” into the “Find feedback” search field in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “1 item matches.” is shown in the count line in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the inbox does not count what the search matches in the list bar’s words).
- **Check:** An Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “6 on this part.” is shown in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the folded row does not say it holds 6).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark in hand (all 6)” button in the “Markup:” article in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “No item matches “week strip”.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the folded row is still in New, or nothing found is not said in the list bar’s words).
- **Step.** Press the “Clear the search” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- _Note:_ Filters: feedback only (inline on a computer, in Filters on a phone), then who sent it (in Filters), each in the address.
- If `phone`:
  - **Step.** Press the “Filters” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- Choose “feedback” in the “Kind” search field.
- A tab's count, as the inbox shows it (`tabCount`).
- Choose “all” in the “Kind” search field.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Step.** Press the “Filters” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- Find and pick: press “From” in the “Filter feedback” dialog, type “jun”, and choose “Jun Park”.
- **Step.** Press the “Show N items” button in the “Filter feedback” dialog.
- **Check:** “Filtered by: From Jun Park” is shown in the filter line in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the person filter is not said in words).
- **Step.** Press the “Remove the filter From” button in the filter line in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** The filter line in the inbox (`#inbox`) goes away.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if search found {found}; {sixInHand} of 6 in hand; feedback filter left {kinds} markups and counts {fbNew} (in the address: {kindLink}); person filter {jun}.
- _Note:_ One at a time: keys on a computer (J moves, I marks in hand, W won't fix), Next on a phone; each opens the next.
- A tab's count, as the inbox shows it (`tabCount`).
- If `phone`:
  - **Step.** Press the open Inbox item in an Inbox row in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Step.** Press the “Next” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Check:** “2 of” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: Next did not go on to the second item).
  - **Step.** Press the “Mark in hand” button in the ibx detail (`.ibx-detail`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Check:** “2 of” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: handling an item did not open the next one).
  - **Step.** Press the “Back to the list” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- Otherwise:
  - Press the j key in the page.
  - Press the i key.
  - Press the w key.
  - **Step.** Type “Seen it: already on the list.” into the “Why it won’t be fixed” field in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Step.** Press the “Won’t fix” button in the mk form in the ibx detail (`.ibx-detail .mk-form`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if J did not move to the next row.
- A tab's count, as the inbox shows it (`tabCount`).
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if one at a time: New went from {before} to {after}.
- _Note:_ A page at a time: tick the page and close the batch as won't fix, until nothing is new.
- Repeated, as the code loops:
  - A tab's count, as the inbox shows it (`tabCount`).
  - **Step.** Press the “Select this page” field in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Step.** Press the “Won’t fix…” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Step.** Type “Closed in the triage of 8 November.” into the “Why it won’t be fixed” field in the ibx bulk (`.ibx-bulk`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - **Step.** Press the “Won’t fix N” button in the mk form in the ibx bulk (`.ibx-bulk .mk-form`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
  - If `rounds === 1`:
    - **Check:** Checkpoint “a batch closed”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** “Nothing new.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the inbox does not say there is nothing new).
- _Note:_ What's in hand, fixed in a batch.
- **Step.** Press the “In hand” tab in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Select this page” field in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark fixed…” button in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Step.** Press the “Mark N fixed” button in the mk form in the ibx bulk (`.ibx-bulk .mk-form`) in the inbox (`#inbox`).
- **Check:** “Nothing is in hand.” is shown in the inbox (`#inbox`) (else: the batch was not marked fixed).
- A tab's count, as the inbox shows it (`tabCount`).
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if the menu says “Nothing new”; Closed holds {closed}.
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if not all closed by Grace: {a value worked out in the journey}.
- Close this browser.
